correctness.rationale: For every m,n>=2, a strict vertex order pairs a vertex to its unique earlier neighbor. Classifying the first two appearances of each bipartition proves an exact cover by m+n star subcomplexes; every star has a dominated-vertex collapse, pairwise cross intersections are two isolated vertices, and no other nonempty intersections occur. Cofibration gluing gives the homotopy type of the directed doubled-edge multigraph, connected with 2mn edges and m+n vertices. The cover and homotopy colimit are equivariant, inducing the full integral kernel description. The row-column-zero lattice gives the canonical bipartition-preserving integral splitting, with trace from the signed chain exact sequence. Exhaustive vertex orders and mod-2 homology for seven sizes through (4,5) agree; 224 automorphism signed Lefschetz checks agree, including 80 part-swap cases. Finite computations are auxiliary, not an infinite proof.

No arbitrary slice or numerical increment is used; one coherent classification and integral symmetry claim is assessed.
